class Base {
  read(this: { need: string }, value: number) { return this.need + value; }
  typed<T>(this: T): T { return this; }
}
class Derived extends Base {
  need = "yes";
  local = 4;
  wrapped() { return (super["read"])(1); }
  wrong() { return super.read("wrong"); }
  generic() { return super["typed"]().local; }
}
